_comment: SEED-018 H3 regression fixture. A small room-artifact set + topic whose pairs, run through the mocked-embedding differential, are NON-degenerate: they do NOT collapse to the boundary extreme (semantic 0.0 / lsa 1.0 / signed_diff -1.0) that the polluted-corpus bug produced. The artifacts share vocabulary (so semantic cosine is > 0) but are distinct (so semantic < 1 and token Jaccard < 1), which lands at least one pair at 0 < semantic < 1 AND abs(signed_diff) < 1.

artifacts.text: Our platform gives teams shared workspaces so multi-user members collaborate with realtime presence while editing shared project documents together.
New team members onboard into shared collaboration workspaces; multi-user presence is core so members feel the team working alongside them from the first project.
Go-to-market targets teams that need collaborative multi-user tooling for shared projects, positioning the platform against single-user editing tools.
